card.portfolioSentence: Portfolio [SIM]: 205 facilities — 203 join candidates, each chosen because it showed a Carbon Mapper plume that MARS did not see, plus the 2 other demo cases; 201 of 205 are sized: ARG_S_055, TKM_S_395, TKM_S_426, USA_S_053 own no Carbon Mapper source (the join matches plumes, ownership uses source centroids; their plumes belong to a nearer target's source) and cannot open an episode; bond = pool = 0.768 ETH, the P90 of one year's rebate exposure.

label: testnet-sized tier amounts (0.005 / 0.003 / 0.001 ETH) [SIM]; policyUnits = the same exposure in VERDICT_ONLY policy units
method: as v1: monthly Poisson passes x per-pass detection (B1s) x payable share x tier mix; <= 1 paid episode per month; summed over the set

pool.why: refunds are capped at the rebate an episode cost, so the pool never needs more than the rebates paid: sized to the same P90; the unreserved remainder returns to sponsors
